summary: Optic nerve head: a vertically oval disc with a central cup and an orange-pink rim. Cupping and rim loss are the signs of glaucoma.

vertical_diameter.note: Jonas et al. 1988 (planimetry, corrected for magnification).

horizontal_diameter.note: Jonas et al. 1988; the disc is slightly vertically oval.

position_x.note: Disc centre from the foveal centre, +x temporal (the disc is nasal). Rohrschneider 2004: 4.76 mm apart, the fovea 7.7 degrees below the disc centre.

position_y.note: Disc centre above the fovea; Rohrschneider 2004.

cup_disc_ratio_vertical.note: Vertical cup diameter over vertical disc diameter. Normal is mostly 0.3 or less; 0.7 or more, or a difference of more than 0.2 between eyes, is suspicious of glaucoma (Kanski 9th ed.).

cup_disc_ratio_horizontal.note: The normal cup is horizontally oval, so its horizontal ratio exceeds the vertical one (Jonas et al. 1988); glaucoma enlarges it vertically first.

cup_decentration_x.note: Cup centre from the disc centre, +x temporal: the temporal rim is the narrowest (ISNT rule); render calibration (low).

cup_decentration_y.note: Cup centre above the disc centre: the inferior rim is the widest (ISNT rule: inferior, superior, nasal, temporal); render calibration (low).

notch_depth.note: Focal rim loss: fraction of the rim width lost at notch_angle. 0 in a healthy disc; a notch is a sign of glaucoma.

notch_angle.note: Where a notch sits, degrees counter-clockwise from temporal on the right eye (270 = inferior). Glaucomatous notches favour the inferotemporal (about 290) and superotemporal poles.

haemorrhage_length.note: Splinter (Drance) haemorrhage at the disc margin, radial length. 0 in a healthy disc; common in normal-tension and progressing glaucoma.

haemorrhage_angle.note: Position of a disc haemorrhage, as notch_angle; most are inferotemporal.

peripapillary_atrophy_width.note: Width of the pale crescent of chorioretinal atrophy at the disc margin (beta zone), widest temporally; larger in glaucoma and myopia; render calibration (low).

rim_colour.note: Linear; the healthy neuroretinal rim is orange-pink, sRGB #db8038. sRGB sampled from the user's wide-field fundus reference (not in the repo), converted to linear; render calibration.

cup_colour.note: Linear; the cup floor (lamina cribrosa) is pale yellow, sRGB #f5cc73. sRGB sampled from the user's wide-field fundus reference (not in the repo), converted to linear; render calibration.

pallor.note: Loss of the rim's pink toward white (atrophy): 0 healthy, 1 a white disc.

measured_by: fundus lens (90D) with a narrow slit
clinical.notes: Fundus coordinates: millimetres on the retina from the foveal centre, +x temporal, +y up, the same for both eyes (the renderer mirrors the left eye).

provenance.source: Jonas, Gusek & Naumann, Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 29:1151 (1988) for disc and cup size; Rohrschneider, Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 45:3257 (2004) for the disc-fovea distance and angle; Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed. for cupping and glaucomatous signs
